members: public BoundedEventChannel(String name, int capacity) { if (capacity <= 0) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity must be positive"); } this.name = name; this.sink = Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(capacity, false); }
public Mono<Void> offer(T event) { return publish(event); }
